notes: Non-obvious source quirk, verified by running the literal Swift function rather than derived by hand: "op ".split(separator: " ", omittingEmptySubsequences: false) produces ["op", ""] (a trailing empty token from the trailing space), so filledTokens = [""] has count 1, and since endsWithSpace is true, slotIndex = filledTokens.count = 1. op has only one argument slot (index 0), so slotIndex 1 fails the `slotIndex < argumentSlots.count` guard and the function returns [] instead of the expected player-name suggestions. Preserved as-is: a real MSC 1 behavior, not a bug this port introduces.
